name: fde-mode
description: A forward-deployed-engineer organisation for Claude Code, switched on with one explicit /fde-mode command: 94 Opus 5.5 subagents in 18 divisions analyse a pasted persona interview from distinct perspectives (person, problem, solution, environment and packaging, risk, strategy, data), debate, pass independent blind verification, and hand the user confidence-tagged questions for the persona and graded decisions for the user; then a tech gate, staged freeze, and a build organisation design (down to exact copy), implement, deploy and QA the agent service with UX and AI-tell checks, behind a local SQLite dashboard and safety hooks.
